recentItems.title: Welcome to the YouTube Music Awards 2015
recentItems.description:
Welcome to the YouTube Music Awards 2015! We announced this year's 50 winners and now we're dropping 13 exclusive new music videos (right here: http://goo.gl/riF084) from Action Bronson ft. Chance the Rapper, Cahoots, Charli XCX, Ed Sheeran & Rudimental, FKA twigs, Kygo ft. Parson James, Lindsey Stirling, Martin Garrix ft. Usher, MAX ft. Hoodie Allen, Migos, Megan Nicole, Nicky Jam & Enrique Iglesias, and Shamir. Let us know which is your favorite!

Get the YTMA 2015 Music Video Playlist here: http://yt.be/oLzT

Subscribe to http://youtube.com/YouTubeMusicAwards

Get a behind-the-scenes look at how Autofuss made this laser-filled launch film for the 2015 YouTube Music Awards : http://youtu.be/z2uatQ7k0Rw

Autofuss Production Credits: http://www.autofuss.com/work/ytma

Grab a free download of the song in this video: https://soundcloud.com/boyesen/you-say-ymta15

Want more? Check out The YouTube Music Awards winners of 2015 (https://youtu.be/IQ52K6Y8JNw) and be sure to save the YTMA 2015 Winner’s Playlist http://goo.gl/LiwcqA

recentItems.title: Announcing the YouTube Music Awards 2015 Show
recentItems.description:
The 2015 YouTube Music Awards honored 50 artists set for a big 2015. On March 23 the YouTube Music Awards Show celebrates them with 13 never-before-seen videos from Ed Sheeran, Max Schneider, Charli XCX and more. Until then, check out all the winners at http://goo.gl/I788mW. And let us know who’s your favorite!

Subscribe to youtube.com/YouTubeMusicAwards and stay tuned for more.
